name: terminal-bridge
description: Opens, renames, and closes VS Code terminal tabs via a local HTTP API

terminalBridge.pipelineStateDir.description: Directory (relative to each workspace folder) that /api/status appends pipeline-state.json into.

terminalBridge.agentId.description: Identity this window's main agent announces to the presence registry (/announce, /api/bridges). Falls back to the workspace name, then the first folder's name, when unset.
